io.github.ghosthack:panama-media-parent 0.1.1 发布, Direct Panama FFM (Java 26) bindings to native media libraries.
        These modules are thin Java wrappers around native C APIs, not frameworks:
        no ImageIO layer, no BufferedImage, and no java.desktop dependency.
        Image modules return raw MemorySegment-backed pixel data plus metadata,
        and consumers choose their own integration and memory lifetime.
